summary: Blanket %2f (case-insensitive) denial in both id/name segments is correct and minimal: verified with a real-server single-decode ASGI simulation that the accepted trade-off (own %2f-named artifact readable via REST double percent-encoding, denied over MCP) actually holds, all four conjuncts (dot-segment, percent-encoded-separator, unicode-confusable, mixed-scheme) have real-dispatch tests, and the two prior rounds' counterexamples (flat and nested %2f traversal) are now denied with no new under- or over-denial relative to REST found.
